description: PATCH /api/v1/auth/me with an email that already belongs to a different account returns 200 and a confirmation mail goes out, instead of the 422 with `emailExists` we expect.
data_flow: userDto.email is looked up with UsersService.findByEmail; if a different user owns it the update must throw emailExists before the confirm-new-email mail is signed and sent
The email is then deleted from userDto, so no later duplicate check runs in UsersService.update
notes: Equality instead of inequality. Because the email differs from the current one (outer guard), the condition can never be true so the duplicate check never fires. UsersService.update has a similar emailAlreadyExists check but it is not reached for this flow.
